2609.00177.title: Do General NLP Embeddings Capture Ontological Reasoning?
2609.00177.paper_summary: General-purpose NLP embedding models perform well on linguistic tasks, but their ability to capture symbolic ontological structure remains unclear. We introduce AVA, a systematic framework for evaluating whether embeddings distinguish logic-sensitive relational semantics in ontologies and knowledge graphs. AVA comprises 171,007 contrastive triplets derived from 163 heterogeneous ontologies using hierarchy inversion, relation substitution, and disjointness injection. Each triplet contains an ontology statement, a semantically equivalent paraphrase, and a logic-sensitive hard negative with contradictory relational meaning. We evaluate more than 25 state-of-the-art embedding models and find substantial limitations: the best model achieves only 0.739 triplet accuracy, while hard negative accuracy falls to 0.135. Fine-tuning improves discrimination by a large margin but transfers poorly to downstream Semantic Web tasks, including taxonomy discovery and ontology alignment. Further analysis suggests that improvements stem partly from perturbation-specific pattern recognition rather than robust ontological understanding. These findings reveal a persistent gap between linguistic representation learning and ontology-level discrimination, challenging the assumption that strong NLP benchmark performance translates to Semantic Web competence.
2609.00177.paper_summary_zh: 通用的自然語言處理嵌入模型在語言任務上表現良好，但它們捕捉符號本體結構的能力仍然不清楚。我們介紹了AVA，一個系統化的框架，用於評估嵌入是否能區分本體和知識圖譜中的邏輯敏感關係語義。AVA包含從163個異質本體中衍生的171,007個對比三元組，使用層次反轉、關係替換和不相交注入。每個三元組包含一個本體陳述、一個語義等價的改述，以及一個具有矛盾關係意義的邏輯敏感硬負樣本。我們評估了25個以上的最先進嵌入模型，發現其存在重大限制：最佳模型的三元組準確率僅為0.739，而硬負樣本的準確率降至0.135。微調在很大程度上改善了區分能力，但在下游語義網任務中轉移效果不佳，包括分類法發現和本體對齊。進一步分析表明，改進部分源於特定擾動的模式識別，而非穩健的本體理解。這些發現揭示了語言表示學習與本體級別區分之間持續存在的差距，挑戰了強大的自然語言處理基準表現能轉化為語義網能力的假設。
